title: He's awful!
description: A bilingual lesson in which Jane asks Pauline about Ron Marston, who has telephoned her four times yesterday and three times the day before yesterday. Pauline tells how her boss answered the phone, how she arrived home at six and he telephoned again, and how her mother told him not to telephone her daughter again. Includes a fill-in dialogue, vocabulary and structure exercises with past-tense verbs, and grammar on regular past tense, sentence-making and did-questions. 课文讲述简问波琳朗·马斯顿的情况——他昨天给波琳打了4次电话，前天打了3次。波琳讲述老板如何接电话、她晚上6点到家后他又打电话、以及她母亲如何对他说不要再给她女儿打电话了。配合教材填空对话、词汇与结构（过去时动词）练习，以及规则动词过去式、仿照例句造句和 did 问句的语法练习。

lesson.text:
Listen then answer this question.
How did Pauline answer the telephone at nine o'clock?
听录音，然后回答问题。波琳在9点接电话时是如何说的？
lesson.translation: Listen then answer this question. How did Pauline answer the telephone at nine o'clock?

lines.speaker: JANE
lines.translation: 简：波琳，朗·马斯顿是怎样一个人？

lines.speaker: PAULINE
lines.text:
He's awful!
He telephoned me four times yesterday,
and three times the day before yesterday.
lines.translation: 波琳：他讨厌透了！他昨天给我打了4次电话，前天打了3次。

lines.speaker: PAULINE
lines.text:
He telephoned the office yesterday morning
and yesterday afternoon.
My boss answered the telephone.
lines.translation: 波琳：他昨天上午和下午把电话打到了我的办公室，是我的老板接的。

lines.speaker: JANE
lines.text: What did your boss say to him?
lines.translation: 简：你老板是怎么对他说的？

lines.speaker: PAULINE
lines.text:
He said, 'Pauline is typing letters.
She can't speak to you now!'
lines.translation: 波琳：他说："波琳正在打信，她现在不能同你讲话！"

lines.speaker: PAULINE
lines.text:
Then I arrived home at six o'clock yesterday evening.
He telephoned again.
But I didn't answer the phone!
lines.translation: 波琳：后来，我昨晚6点钟回到家。他又打来电话，但我没接。

lines.speaker: JANE
lines.text: Did he telephone again last night?
lines.translation: 简：他昨天夜里又打电话了吗？

lines.speaker: PAULINE
lines.text:
Yes, he did.
He telephoned at nine o'clock.
lines.translation: 波琳：是的，打了。他在9点钟又打来了电话。

lines.speaker: JANE
lines.text: What did you say to him?

lines.speaker: PAULINE
lines.text:
I said, 'This is Pauline's mother.
Please don't telephone my daughter again!'
lines.translation: 波琳：我说："我是波琳的母亲。请不要再给我女儿打电话了！"

items.title: He telephoned me four times yesterday.
items.text: 他昨天给我打了4次电话。be 动词以外的动词在过去时中一般有两种形式。规则动词一般是在动词后面加 ed，如 answer/answered；以 e 结尾的规则动词加 d，如 telephone/telephoned, arrive/arrived。另一部分动词的过去式拼写不规则，因此称为不规则动词，如 say/said, do/did。从本课开始，单词表中的不规则动词除列出原形外，还将在括号中列出过去式的拼写和读音。

items.title: 一般过去时的时间状语
items.text: 一般过去时的句子中常常有表示过去某一时刻的时间状语，如本课中的 yesterday（昨天），the day before yesterday（前天），yesterday morning（昨天上午），yesterday afternoon（昨天下午），yesterday evening（昨天晚上），last night（昨夜）。

lesson.text:
参考译文
简：波琳，朗·马斯顿是怎样一个人？
波琳：他讨厌透了！他昨天给我打了4次电话，前天打了3次。

波琳：他昨天上午和下午把电话打到了我的办公室，是我的老板接的。

简：你老板是怎么对他说的？
波琳：他说："波琳正在打信，她现在不能同你讲话！"

波琳：后来，我昨晚6点钟回到家。他又打来电话，但我没接。

简：他昨天夜里又打电话了吗？
波琳：是的，打了。他在9点钟又打来了电话。

简：你对他怎么说的？
波琳：我说："我是波琳的母亲。请不要再给我女儿打电话了！"

简：他又打了没有？
波琳：没有！

grammar.title: II. Make sentences according to the example. 仿照例句造句。
grammar.instruction: Make sentences according to the example. 仿照例句造句。
grammar.translation: Make a sentence using the given cues, following the printed example.
grammar.context: Item 1 is a printed example and is not editable. The remaining items follow the same pattern (present simple + but + past simple).

questions.prompt: Mary/walk/along the beach/along the bank of the river/yesterday
questions.answer: Mary often walks along the beach, but she walked along the bank of the river yesterday.

questions.prompt: the boys/play/in the playground/in the garden/yesterday afternoon
questions.answer: The boys often play in the playground, but they played in the garden yesterday afternoon.

questions.prompt: Bob/study/in the classroom/in the library/yesterday morning
questions.answer: Bob often studies in the classroom, but he studied in the library yesterday morning.

questions.prompt: Mr. Zhang/stay/at home/at night/in the office/last night
questions.answer: Mr. Zhang often stays at home at night, but he stayed in the office last night.

questions.prompt: she/watch television/in the evening/listen to the stereo/yesterday evening
questions.answer: She often watches television in the evening, but she listened to the stereo yesterday evening.

questions.prompt: Peter/shave/in the morning/at noon/the day before yesterday
questions.answer: Peter often shaves in the morning, but he shaved at noon the day before yesterday.

questions.prompt: my husband/arrive home/at about five/at six/yesterday evening
questions.answer: My husband usually arrives home at about five, but he arrived at six yesterday evening.

questions.prompt: you/want/oranges/bananas/yesterday
questions.answer: You often want oranges, but you wanted bananas yesterday.

questions.prompt: it/rain/in October/snow/yesterday
questions.answer: It often rains in October, but it snowed yesterday.

questions.prompt: he/walk to work/at seven forty-five/at seven fifteen/yesterday morning
questions.answer: He often walks to work at seven forty-five, but he walked at seven fifteen yesterday morning.

grammar.title: III. Answer the questions according to the example. 仿照例句回答下列问题。
grammar.instruction: Answer the questions according to the example. 仿照例句回答下列问题。
grammar.translation: Answer each did-question with a short answer and a full sentence, following the printed example.
grammar.context: Item 1 is a printed example and is not editable. The remaining items follow the same pattern; each numbered item contains two questions, both answered in one field.

questions.prompt: Did he paint the chairs? / Did he wash the dishes?
questions.answer:
Yes, he did. He painted them.
No, he didn't. He didn't wash them.

questions.prompt: Did Marie wash the cups? / Did Peter wash the glasses?
questions.answer:
Yes, she did. She washed them.
No, he didn't. He didn't wash them.

questions.prompt: Did he enjoy himself? / Did she enjoy herself?
questions.answer:
Yes, he did. He enjoyed himself.
Yes, she did. She enjoyed herself.

questions.prompt: Did Martin dry the spoons? / Did Martin dry the forks?
questions.answer:
Yes, he did. He dried them.
No, he didn't. He didn't dry them.

questions.prompt: Did Jane clean the floor? / Did Tom dust the shelves?
questions.answer:
Yes, she did. She cleaned it.
No, he didn't. He didn't dust them.

questions.prompt: Did he sharpen the knife? / Did he empty the basket?
questions.answer:
Yes, he did. He sharpened it.
No, he didn't. He didn't empty it.

questions.prompt: Did your mother cook the meal? / Did she bake any bread?
questions.answer:
Yes, she did. She cooked it.
No, she didn't. She didn't bake any bread.

questions.prompt: Did you turn on the tap? / Did you turn off the cooker?
questions.answer:
Yes, I did. I turned it on.
No, I didn't. I didn't turn it off.

questions.prompt: Did Mary telephone her boss? / Did she telephone her sister?
questions.answer:
Yes, she did. She telephoned her.
No, she didn't. She didn't telephone her.

questions.prompt: Did you open the door? / Did you open the windows?
questions.answer:
Yes, I did. I opened it.
No, I didn't. I didn't open them.
